clips.send: Someone who just paid for a coaching program sends this to a friend about to do the same - anger at realizing the coach selling success has none of it himself.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau has a warning about most self-help and success coaches out there.

He says look at who's teaching you. If a so-called success coach is living in his mother's basement, 80 pounds overweight, with health problems he can't fix, how is he qualified to coach you on success?

Kevin Trudeau's rule: you can't teach what you don't have. He refused to teach a single seminar until after he had already made millions himself.

Who's actually teaching you, and what have they built?

#kevintrudeau #success #mindset #selfhelp #money #wealthmindset
